definitions: plan and direct the route or course of a ship, aircraft, or other form of transport, especially by using instruments or maps.
travel on a desired course after planning the route.
guide (a vehicle or vessel) over, round, or through (a difficulty or obstacle).
move around a website or the internet.
examples: The crew navigated the ship through the storm.
He navigated his way through the crowded streets.
She navigated the complex legal system.
Users can navigate the site easily.
